# omada_controller_certificate (Resource)

Manages the TLS certificate for the Omada SDN Controller.

## Software Controller 6.1.0.19

After applying a certificate, restart the controller for its HTTPS listener to serve it. The provider saves the configuration and reports a warning; it does not restart the controller. Schedule the restart and verify the new certificate before relying on it for TLS trust.

The controller converts PEM uploads to stored JKS identities. Computed `cert_id` and `key_id` reflect settings readback and may differ from upload IDs. Destroying this resource only removes Terraform state; it leaves the controller certificate configured.


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificate_pem` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded certificate (public key) for the Omada Controller. Can be a single leaf certificate or a full chain (leaf + intermediates + root).
- `private_key_pem` (String, Sensitive) The PEM-encoded private key for the Omada Controller certificate.

### Read-Only

- `cert_id` (String) The certificate ID stored by the controller after activation (computed).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the controller certificate resource. Always set to 'controller-cert'.
- `key_id` (String) The private key ID stored by the controller after activation (computed).
